name: Shams al-Dīn Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ruʿaynī al-Ḥaṭṭāb
summary: Mālikī jurist of Mecca of Maghribi family, author of the great commentary on Mukhtaṣar Khalīl and of Mutammimat al-Ājurrūmiyya, the completion of Ibn Ājurrūm's primer.
bio: Al-Ḥaṭṭāb was born in Mecca in 902/1497 to a family from the Maghrib and became one of the leading Mālikī jurists of his age; his Mawāhib al-Jalīl on the Mukhtaṣar of Khalīl is a standard work of the school.

For grammar he wrote Mutammimat al-Ājurrūmiyya, which keeps al-Ājurrūmiyya's order and adds what the short text leaves out; it is read between al-Ājurrūmiyya and Qaṭr al-nadā, and al-Ahdal's al-Kawākib al-durriyya is a commentary on it. He died in 954/1547.
